My experience has been extremely disappointing, and I feel compelled to raise several issues that have not only affected my well-being but have also raised serious concerns regarding the quality of care and the accuracy of information provided to secondary services.
Registration Issues
I am unsure why I have been registered at this surgery, considering I reside at the Broomfield end of Beaulieu. I originally applied to register with the Beaulieu surgery, which is within walking distance of my home. The current arrangement is both inconvenient and inexplicable,
Concerns Over Incorrect Information
More seriously, I have discovered that incorrect and non-factual information has been passed on to secondary services. This misinformation has caused unnecessary complications and distress. As a result, I am considering taking formal steps with the General Medical Council (GMC) to ensure that this matter is investigated thoroughly and that appropriate action is taken.
Insensitive and Inadequate GP Conduct
During my appointments, I found the GP to be highly insensitive to my concerns. My queries were not properly addressed, and it was clear that the GP did not take the time to look into my situation. Instead, I felt dismissed and ignored, which has had a devastating impact on my life and well-being. The behaviour displayed was totally inappropriate for a healthcare professional, leaving me feeling unseen and unheard.
